objective: Test whether candidate-conditioned correction of predictable terminal visual forecast error improves selected physical outcomes under the native unchanged visual+proprio goal objective.
site: Native predicted terminal visual output, full256x384; mechanistic output-correction comparison, not an internal P3 residual edit or model weight update.
fit: Exactly16 existing fit initial-state groups,7 actions each; all training rows retained. No development or confirmation target enters fitting.
development: All4 existing expanded64-plan development banks, total256plans. Initial state is the independent unit; these are adaptively reused exploratory states.
features: Current visual mean384, predicted terminal visual mean384, normalized60 action coordinates; fit standardization only.
ridge: 0.1 times mean training kernel diagonal; no development tuning
rbf_bandwidth: median positive TRAIN squared feature distance
knn: 8nearest training rows, at most2 from each training initialstate; exponential distance weights
controls: fixed seed permutation of TRAIN residual labels, test-edit norm matched
fixed signed coordinate permutation of predicted residual, exact per-candidate norm matched
native_objective: Unchanged terminal visual squared error mean plus0.1proprio error; proprio unchanged. Exact noedit original scalar costs and argmins preserved.
primary: Requested expert-goal polygon coverage of selected actual30-step physical outcome; this NEW experiment declares goal-matched coverage in advance and does not rewrite old4DXY-primary experiments.
secondary: native reward against its different painted goal remains separately labelled
promotion: Mean coverage gain>=0.02 versus native AND each matched sham, positive coverage gain in>=3of4states versus native, no state harm>0.05coverage, and average forecastMSE<=1.05native. Then freeze one smallest-cap candidate for fresh development validation; no full held evaluation from these4states.
additional_prespecified_branch: If correction fails, predict per-candidate visual error risk using identical TRAIN features and three fit families. Penalize nativecost by nonnegative predicted risk at strengths0.1,0.3,1 scaled from TRAIN median nativecost/error. Controls: within-state candidate-permutation penalty and TRAIN-scaled action-magnitude penalty. This is planner score intervention, reported separately.
resources: Existing projectGPUs398/413/414 exclusively, <=1.5aggregate processGPUhours initial checkpoint; no new rentals; no other GPU use.
